```{r, fig.height=8, fig.width=15, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(jsonlite)
library(stringr)

j <- fromJSON("conf_matrix_data.json", simplifyVector = TRUE)

# Extract all confusion matrices
keys <- grep("^confusion_matrix_epoch_\\d+(?:_train)?$", names(j), value = TRUE)

cm <- map_dfr(keys, function(k) {
  m <- str_match(k, "^confusion_matrix_epoch_(\\d+)(?:(_train))?$")
  epoch   <- as.integer(m[1,2])
  dataset <- ifelse(!is.na(m[1,3]) && m[1,3] == "_train", "Train", "Test")

  x <- j[[k]]
  mat <- if (is.list(x)) do.call(rbind, x) else as.matrix(x)
  storage.mode(mat) <- "numeric"

  stopifnot(nrow(mat) == 2, ncol(mat) == 2)

  class_labels <- c("fake", "real")

  tibble(
    epoch = epoch,
    dataset = dataset,
    true_label = factor(class_labels, levels = class_labels)
  ) |>
    bind_cols(as_tibble(mat, .name_repair = ~ paste0("pred_", class_labels))) |>
    pivot_longer(starts_with("pred_"),
                 names_to = "pred_label", values_to = "n") |>
    mutate(pred_label = factor(sub("^pred_", "", pred_label),
                               levels = class_labels))
})

# Row-normalize
cm_prop <- cm |>
  group_by(dataset, epoch, true_label) |>
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) |>
  ungroup()

fill_low  <- "#E8EEF4"
fill_high <- "#4169E1"

# Combined plot (Train/Test as rows, Epoch as columns)
p_cm <- ggplot(cm_prop, aes(pred_label, true_label, fill = prop)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", prop)),
            color = "#111111", size = 3.6) +
  facet_grid(dataset ~ epoch,
             labeller = labeller(epoch = function(x) paste0("Epoch ", x))) +
  scale_fill_gradient(limits = c(0,1), low = fill_low, high = fill_high,
                      name = "Proportion") +
  labs(
    title = "Confusion Matrices per Epoch",
    subtitle = "Row-normalized (True = rows, Pred = columns)",
    x = "Predicted label",
    y = "True label"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 17, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 8))
  )

# Train plot
p_train <- cm_prop %>%
  filter(dataset == "Train") %>%
  ggplot(aes(pred_label, true_label, fill = prop)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", prop)), color = "#111111", size = 3.6) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ epoch,
    nrow = 1,
    labeller = labeller(epoch = function(x) paste0("Epoch ", x))
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    low = fill_low,
    high = fill_high,
    name = "Proportion"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Train Confusion Matrices (Row-normalized)",
    x = "Predicted",
    y = "True"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 10)
  )

# Test plot
p_test <- cm_prop %>%
  filter(dataset == "Test") %>%
  ggplot(aes(pred_label, true_label, fill = prop)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", prop)), color = "#111111", size = 3.6) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ epoch,
    nrow = 2,
    ncol = 3,
    labeller = labeller(epoch = function(x) paste0("Epoch ", x))
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    low = fill_low,
    high = fill_high,
    name = "Proportion"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Test Confusion Matrices (Row-normalized)",
    x = "Predicted",
    y = "True"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )

# Save plots
ggsave("confmat_combined.png", p_cm, width = 14, height = 7, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
if (any(cm_prop$dataset == "Train"))
  ggsave("confmat_train.png",  p_train, width = 5, height = 2.7, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
if (any(cm_prop$dataset == "Test"))
  ggsave("confmat_test.png",   p_test,  width = 6.66, height = 4.66, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
print(p_train)
print(p_test)
```


```{r, fig.height=8, fig.width=15, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

loss <- read_csv("train_losses.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  arrange(step)

col_line  <- "#1B4F72"
grid_col  <- "#D9D9D9"
axis_col  <- "#333333"

# Keep first point + every 5th for readability
loss_plot <- loss %>% arrange(step) %>%
  filter(row_number() == 1 | row_number() %% 5 == 0)

col_line <- "#1B4F72"; grid_col <- "#D9D9D9"; axis_col <- "#333333"

first_hi <- loss_plot %>% slice(1) %>% filter(train_loss > 1.5)
x_offset <- 180
epoch_steps <- c(842, 1684, 2526, 3368, 4210, 5052)

# Plot loss over steps
p <- ggplot(loss_plot, aes(step, train_loss)) +
  geom_line(color = col_line, linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = epoch_steps,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "#000000",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = epoch_steps,
    y = 0.7,                     
    label = paste("Epoch", 1:6),
    angle = 0,                   
    vjust = 0,
    hjust = 2.2,
    size = 3.5,
    color = "#000000"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 0.7)) +
  labs(
    title = "Training Loss Over Steps",
    subtitle = "Every 5th step shown.",
    x = "Step", y = "Training loss"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = grid_col, linewidth = 0.4),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = axis_col, linewidth = 0.6),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = axis_col, linewidth = 0.6),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "grey30", margin = margin(b = 8))
  )

# Save figure
ggsave("training_loss_plot.png", p, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
print(p)
```
